residuals.location: Native shirt and both pouch surfaces
residuals.observation: Cotton surfaces show a repeated raised/wavy, loop-like wrinkle texture more uniformly than initial; this is especially apparent on the dark bands and plain terracotta pouch at native detail and reduces natural knit variation.
Four participation lines are readable but visually smaller than the attendance block. Actual font family and rendered font point size are unverified raster properties.

The shirt extends substantially below the assigned planning rectangle to about y272 at usage720. The collar, sleeve junction and hem remain visible, and the extension stays clear of title/copy. No client composition-preservation reference was supplied.

located_observations.observation: Exactly three visible dark transverse bars: narrow upper, broad middle, medium lower, with wider upper cream gap and narrow lower gap. Lower stripe remains above stitched hem; asymmetrical red triangular corner is retained.

located_observations.location: Lower-left cream/ink pouch front and base
located_observations.observation: The same three-bar order and unequal cream-gap order are visible, truncated at side seams. Red asymmetric stitched base corner corresponds to the source shirt patch.
Three discrete bars can be counted on each object; the lower stripe is visibly distinct from hem or shadow. Pattern and red corner give visible material correspondence across the title interval.

located_observations.location: Pouch pair and separate adult palms
located_observations.observation: Each zipper mouth, side seam and bottom edge is visible; separate palms support objects and offer them inward. Fingers are separate without a tangled handoff; objects do not float.

Hangul syllable counters, upright strokes and word spaces are legible. The time range uses a medium-length horizontal dash, both colons remain clear; centered dots, comma and ampersand are visible. No extra words or pseudo-print were seen.

located_observations.location: Central identity and two cream factual islands
located_observations.observation: Title first, adjacent activity next, upper-left attendance via shared left edge, then lower-right participation by the continuous clear field. Every practical entry reads at this actual 720×405 display.

Dominant horizontal middle title, upper-right source garment and lower-left inward-offered pouches form opposing masses; two fact islands stay visible. Three bands remain discernible as bounded object patterns.

Garment and pouches retain shallow consistent shadows, stitched seams and soft cotton thickness. The added bars follow oblique cloth surfaces rather than crossing type or hands. Repeated loop texture is the local finish limitation.
